item.title: Thermodynamic Self-Sufficiency and Cyber-Physical Resiliency in Smackover DLE Repurposing
item.description: We empirically demonstrate that co-locating Direct Lithium Extraction (DLE) with binary-cycle Organic Rankine Cycle geothermal recovery within depleted Smackover petroleum wellbores produces 1.949 MWe of surplus electrical power (EROI = 11.38) and achieves a net-negative lifecycle carbon delta of -14.82 kg CO2e/kg LCE. Downhole multiphase hydraulics are secured via NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3 Navier-Stokes invariants precluding Modbus sensor spoofing. Statutory evaluation under IRA Section 45X confirms $4,424,532.00 USD annual production credits, while an algorithmic Waqf civic trust dedicates $3,160,000.00 USD annually to regional clean water distillation and veteran transition.
